Tambayar dabara ita ce horon ƙira — tafiyar da bin doka, gudanar da AI, shaida ta juriya na ICT, da zaɓuɓɓukan bayanai masu cin gashin kai a matsayin gine-gine ɗaya, ba shirye-shirye biyar a layi ɗaya ba.
